One firm, so the per-firm cap shapes the waves: at most 15 first emails to Finch Data in any 30 days — the rest run in later monthly waves, planned that way from the start. Sources, in order: your own LinkedIn export, names you paste, your school's alumni directory, and firm team pages — every name carries its source, and nobody is emailed on a guessed address.
